prompt:
Bold clean ink linework, flat vibrant cell-shaded colors, rounded expressive character designs, distinctive 1980s Akira Toriyama manga aesthetic. Create ONE finished landscape 1536x1024 comic panel, NOT a character sheet. Alien civilization world, grey-purple ruins, ochre sand, stone cairns. Sky state strictly follow scene. Never use modern laboratory. 
SCENE: 풀 페이지. 게임의 잿빛 세계는 완전히 사라졌다. 어둠. 그리고 그 어둠 속에 별 — 진짜 별. 빈 화면에 하나의 메시지만:
Visible named cast: none. Character sheets are identity references ONLY; never copy their backgrounds. Wang Miao always wears pale blue-grey shirt and dark trousers. All lettering and exact digits will be added later: NO readable text, numbers, symbols, balloons, captions or watermark in generated artwork. Clean coherent anatomy, strong ink composition, no extra characters or alien creatures. Non-graphic disaster where described.
